kyoto_sushi_taka_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and side dishes — uzaku, ankimo, squid tempura, chawanmushi, red miso soup; soy sauce and tsume not described (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_taka_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 16:00–21:30; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 on a raised tatami platform (Tabelog). Off Yamato-oji south of Shijo in Gion, near Keihan Gion-Shijo; moved here in August 2010 after earlier sites in Gion and on Teramachi (Tabelog). Real wasabi (June 2025).
kyoto_sushi_taka_gion.notes: [Sushi · Gion off Yamato-oji, a warm neighbourhood counter] A small, homely sushi counter off Yamato-oji where regulars drink over crab, uni, ankimo and chawanmushi and finish with nigiri and red miso soup — heartfelt rather than refined, at about ¥10,000 with drinks. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a warm, friendly atmosphere made by the chef and the owner (December 2024) and count it among the few small, reasonably priced sushi counters in Gion run by couples (June 2025). Tabelog notes moves from 祇園町北側 (2010) and Teramachi-Takoyakushi (2007).

anecdotes.text: A couple come every year at the end of December; in 2025 it was packed and lively.
A June 2025 guest, a fan of individually run places, found the anago melted in the mouth.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮨嵩、寿司、東山区大和大路四条下る大和町21-1、祇園四条駅から145m、月〜土 16:00〜21:30、日曜定休、現金のみ、16席 (カウンター8、小上がり8)、2010年8月に祇園町北側282-5から、2007年7月に寺町蛸薬師から移転。口コミ (2024〜2025年、英語): 蟹と塩うにの先付、本わさび、赤だし、とろける穴子、うざく、あん肝、いかの天ぷら、茶碗蒸し、まぐろ、鯛、ぶり、うなぎ、サーモン、うに、玉子の握り、飲んで1万円ほど、料理人と店主の温かい雰囲気、夫婦で営む小さな店のひとつ。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; cash only.

kyoto_yakiniku_maumu_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. A5 Wagyu yakiniku with a house sauce described as additive-free, plus yukhoe, namul, kimchi and salads; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_maumu_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Wagyu yakiniku restaurant; namul and kimchi are sides (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_maumu_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30; dinner 17:00–3:00 (L.O. 2:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; 2026). Cards including UnionPay, IC cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 36 seats: 10 at the counter, 16 at tables; room for strollers between tables (Tabelog; October 2026). On the ground floor of the UGK Building in an alley between Kawaramachi and Kiyamachi, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi or Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; 2026).
kyoto_yakiniku_maumu_kiyamachi.notes: [Yakiniku · Kiyamachi alley, A5 Wagyu until 3:00] A calm, modern yakiniku room in a quiet alley off Kiyamachi serving hand-cut A5 Wagyu — yukhoe, thick tongue, yaki-shabu, harami — with namul and kimchi, at lunch and until 3:00. Sister of BISTRO MAUMU and the Gion Yakiniku Maumu. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T6130001067887 is registered to 株式会社ＧＭＩ (NTA register), the operator also recorded for BISTRO MAUMU in our data, which runs 焼肉マウム in Gion and 居酒屋 マウム. Tabelog’s shop text describes female-cattle A5 Wagyu hand-cut by skilled staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Additive-free house sauce to bring out the meat (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular of the Gion branch tried this one with friends as the first stop of a night out.
An October 2026 family found space between tables for a stroller and let the staff season the meat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉 マウム 京都木屋町店、焼肉・ホルモン、中京区北車屋町265-1 UGKビル1F、阪急河原町駅・京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜14:30、夜17:00〜翌3:00 (L.O.2:30)、水曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、36席 (カウンター10、テーブル16)、雌牛のA5黒毛和牛を職人が手切り、無添加の自家製だれ、適格請求書 T6130001067887 (株式会社ＧＭＩ)。口コミ (2026年、英語): ナムル盛り800円、キムチ3種800円、チョレギサラダ800円、和牛ユッケ1,600円、上タン2,300円、ブリスケの焼きしゃぶ1,500円、ヒレ塩1,400円、カルビたれ1,680円、ハラミ、上カルビ、ミノ、ホソ、チャミスル1,320円、祇園店もある。

kyoto_shusai_isami_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese dishes — sashimi, simmered and grilled fish, tempura, suppon courses with fried suppon and hot pot; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shusai_isami_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, duck and soft-shell turtle dishes (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_shusai_isami_kiyamachi.hours_raw: 18:00–5:00 (L.O. 4:00); days off not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; August 2026). Otoshi ¥550 per person (Tabelog, original お通し代 お一人様550円). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 39 seats, all on tatami with sunken kotatsu (Tabelog; June 2025). On the 2nd floor up a steep stair, on Kiyamachi south of Sanjo; the toilet is outside (August and November 2025). About 3 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_shusai_isami_kiyamachi.notes: [Japanese izakaya · Kiyamachi 2F, fish and suppon until 5:00] A tatami-floored izakaya up a steep stair on Kiyamachi, where a chef with French training cooks seasonal fish, tempura, kappo dishes and year-round soft-shell turtle courses, with plenty of sake and free-flow plans. ¥550 otoshi; open until 5:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text says the owner-chef has experience in French cooking and adds original dishes to Kyoto and other Japanese food. Tabelog’s invoice number T4130001063137 is registered to 株式会社いさむ at the shop’s address (NTA register). A February 2026 reviewer mentions a one-person operation that night.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 first-timer at soft-shell turtle got through the fried suppon but left half the porridge, too full to finish.
An August 2026 pair chose it for fish on a second stop and booked a 90-minute free-flow plan with a coupon.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒肴いさ味、居酒屋・海鮮・すっぽん、中京区河原町通三条下る二丁目北車屋町265-1、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、18:00〜翌5:00 (L.O.4:00)、不定休、お通し代1人550円、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、39席、全席座敷 (掘りごたつ)、割烹料理と創作和食、旬の魚、天ぷら、通年のすっぽん料理、フレンチ出身の店主、適格請求書 T4130001063137 (株式会社いさむ)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): すっぽんのコース (前菜、刺身、煮物、唐揚げ、鍋、雑炊)、湯葉の先付・刺身・煮物・焼き魚・天ぷら・味噌汁・おにぎりのコースと飲み放題で約6,000円、90分飲み放題5,500円、鉄板焼き、鴨、カツ、寒ぶり、日本酒が豊富、急な階段、トイレは外。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off, tatami seating; steep stairs; ¥550 otoshi.

kyoto_men_sakaba_hakoya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yellow Chinese wheat noodles in a niku-soba-style broth, with tenkasu (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_men_sakaba_hakoya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat-topped noodles in a meat-and-dashi broth (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_men_sakaba_hakoya.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00 (L.O. 2:30) daily; until 5:00 on the eve of holidays (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter seats only (June 2026). Self-service tenkasu, plain and spicy (June and December 2025). In Kiyamachi near Sanjo, about 280 m from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog). Opened 18 May 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_men_sakaba_hakoya.notes: [Noodle bar · Kiyamachi, after-drinks niku soba] A small counter in Kiyamachi for the end of a night out, serving bowls of thin-sliced meat over yellow noodles in a light, golden broth (¥1,200), with spicy tenkasu to add yourself, curry soba and mazesoba. Cash only; open until 3:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a niku-soba-like dish made with Chinese noodles, with tenkasu at the counter to add yourself — more like a soba or udon shop than a ramen shop (December 2025) — and a regular’s favourite after drinks (March and May 2026).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular, on a fifth visit after drinks, got to try the new mazesoba before its April launch.
A June 2026 visitor was sent here for a late bowl by a local obanzai restaurant.

kyoto_ozu_kyoto_maison_du_sake.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: parfaits with cookies and sponge cake, pancake sandwiches and cheesecake (2020–2025 reviews); ask about rice balls and amazake.
kyoto_ozu_kyoto_maison_du_sake.vegan_detail: Ask: amazake and plum shaved ice may suit, but parfaits use cream and ice cream, and no source says what goes into the sake-lees soup (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ozu_kyoto_maison_du_sake.hours_raw: Tabelog: Fri–Sun 11:30–19:30 (food last order 18:30, drinks 19:00); closed Monday to Thursday. The operator's page gives weekdays 11:30–18:00 and weekends and holidays 10:30–18:00 — check before going. Reservations taken; about 9–10 seats (one table for four and a short counter), so groups may be turned away (August 2024). Pay first; cash, cards, transit IC, PayPay and other QR. Take-away sweets. Non-smoking; children welcome. Ground floor of a small hotel on Yamatooji below Shijo (Tabelog: ホテルRinn; operator: ホテル鈴). Opened here 2 October 2020 (Tabelog) after a move (November 2020 review).
kyoto_ozu_kyoto_maison_du_sake.notes: [Café & sake bar · Yamatooji near Kenninji, deer parfaits and sake-lees soup] A tiny wood-toned café on the ground floor of a Gion hotel, run by a Kyoto kaiseki company: deer-cookie matcha parfaits, summer shaved ice, sake-lees soup with miso rice balls, and sake by the glass. One person often makes everything, so expect a wait. Open Friday–Sunday per Tabelog — check hours.

chef_bio.background: Run by Tatsuuma Corporation (辰馬コーポレーション), which also runs the Kyoto kaiseki house せんしょう in Ukyo and, since June 2025, おづ おむすびカフェ at Bivi Nijo (operator site). Reviewers tie the café to a Nishinomiya sake brewery through the president's family and note sweets made with its daiginjo (2023–2025). It moved to this hotel ground floor in 2020 (November 2020 review). An August 2024 reviewer warns that "one staff member prepares everything in sequence, which does result in a wait time".

anecdotes.text: January 2021: "The parfait came with a deer-shaped cookie! It's adorable, but the cookie is quite large (laughs)."
August 2024: "During our stay, two groups were turned away due to being full."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 運営会社のサイト: 祇園おづ［cafe & SAKE Bar］、京都市東山区大和大路通四条下ル3博多町67 ホテル鈴1F、月〜金 11:30〜18:00、土日祝 10:30〜18:00、パフェやチーズケーキと日本酒・和惣菜、テイクアウト。辰馬コーポレーションは京料理・京会席 せんしょう、祇園おづを運営し、2025年6月20日に Bivi二条に「おづ おむすびカフェ」をオープン。食べログ: おづkyoto‐maison du sake plus Cafe‐、日本料理・カフェ・日本酒バー、東山区博多町67 ホテルRinn 1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、金〜日 11:30〜19:30 (料理 L.O. 18:30、ドリンク L.O. 19:00)、月〜木休み、予約可、10席、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・QR可、2020年10月2日オープン、姉妹店の料理人によるふかひれ丼と粕汁。口コミ (2020年11月〜2026年4月、英語): 移転してホテルの1階へ、鹿のクッキーのパフェ (祇園抹茶894円、桃990円)、抹茶白玉かき氷990円、梅のかき氷、チョコパフェ1,000円、甘酒りんごパフェ、甘酒、パンケーキサンド、大吟醸のチーズケーキ、酒粕汁と味噌おむすび、日本酒、先払い、ひとりで順に作るので待つ (2024年8月)。

kyoto_bar_silent_third_gokomachi.gf_detail: Ask: a whisky and cocktail bar with no food described; check beer and liqueurs (2016–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_silent_third_gokomachi.vegan_detail: Ask: drinks only in the sources; some cocktails use cream, egg or honey (2016–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_silent_third_gokomachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 14:00–24:00; closing days not fixed. Call ahead for space (May 2026). Smoking allowed. Cards (JCB, Amex, Diners per Tabelog). A Y- or L-shaped counter and one sofa table for four (July 2022; July 2024). 2nd floor of 伽羅ビル on Gokomachi below Rokkaku. Open since about 2014 ("four years" in November 2018).
kyoto_bar_silent_third_gokomachi.notes: [Whisky & cocktail bar · Gokomachi near Rokkaku, open from 2 pm] A moody second-floor bar with a long counter and walls of bottles, pouring from 2 pm: the namesake Silent Third cocktail built on the whisky you like, sharp gin and tonics and rare bourbons. Some reviewers find the welcome cool at first. Smoking allowed. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say it opened around 2014 and comes from the Bar K6 line (November 2018; July 2022); one in July 2022 thought it "appears to be run by a single person", with paintings by the same hand on the walls, while a July 2024 group met the owner and female staff. Reviews praise skill and knowledge; criticism: "the service to be somewhat off-putting" (September 2022) and an atmosphere that is "just okay" (July 2022).

anecdotes.text: January 2019: "When I ordered at Silent Third, they asked me what base whisky I preferred, and I requested something peaty. It turned out to be Caol Ila."
July 2024: "The staff were wonderful; they looked a bit cold at first, but were very kind."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー サイレント サード、バー、中京区御幸町六角下ル伊勢屋町354-1 伽羅ビル 2F、毎日 14:00〜24:00、不定休、喫煙可、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2016年11月〜2026年5月、英語): 昼2時から飲めるバー、店名のカクテル「サイレントサード」は好みのウイスキーで (グレンモーレンジィ、カリラ)、スター・オブ・ボンベイのジントニック、度数の高いバーボンのハイボール、余市、オリジナルラベルのスペイサイド、シンガポールスリング、マティーニ、コスモポリタン、K6 の系譜、2014年ごろ開店、ひとりで営むように見える (2022年7月)、接客が合わないという声 (2022年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Classic bar; smoking allowed.

kyoto_bar_ezo_shimizucho.gf_detail: Ask: cocktails and spirits may suit; the food includes pasta, omurice and baguette (official site; 2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_bar_ezo_shimizucho.vegan_detail: Ask: fresh-fruit cocktails and juices (2025–2026 reviews); the food includes cream pasta and omurice.
kyoto_bar_ezo_shimizucho.hours_raw: Tabelog and official site: Tue–Sun 17:00–24:00; closed Monday. Reservations taken; group bookings 21:00–23:00 by arrangement; private hire for 12–30 by phone. Table charge ¥500 — Tabelog, Japanese original 「500円」. 29 seats: counter, sofas and an open terrace (smoking on the terrace only). Pets welcome; English menu; wheelchair access; free Wi-Fi. Cards and e-money (Edy, QUICPay); no QR. Ground floor of a small hotel (MYK HOUSE, March 2018) on a back street west of the Kamo River near Shimizucho. Opened 23 February 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bar_ezo_shimizucho.notes: [Cocktail bar · back street by the Kamo below Shijo, terrace and a Hokkaido master] A roomy bar with sofas and an open terrace on the ground floor of a small hotel, run by a friendly master from Hokkaido: cocktails made to your taste, fresh-fruit drinks, good whisky and, on request, pasta. ¥500 charge. Smoking on the terrace only; pets welcome. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 February 2018 (Tabelog) on the ground floor of a hotel guests often use for long stays (July 2020). Reviewers describe the master as "from Hokkaido" (July 2020) and "friendly and engaging" (December 2025), with other staff who explain the drinks in detail (April 2024). Pasta was dropped from the menu, "possibly due to staffing issues", but was made on request in December 2025.

anecdotes.text: July 2020: "The master was so cool while shaking the cocktails that I went home the next day and bought a cocktail shaker myself!"
December 2025: "My wife, who doesn't drink alcohol, always requests fresh juice made from fruits."

kyoto_sumiyaki_miyazawa_gion.gf_detail: Ask: salt-grilled skewers may suit, but the secret tare, meat miso, ramen and curry do not (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumiyaki_miyazawa_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori counter; vegetable skewers exist, but nothing is described as vegan (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumiyaki_miyazawa_gion.hours_raw: Tabelog: from 18:00 until sold out; closed Sundays and public holidays; hours may change. Reservations strongly advised — 10 counter seats, often full (2024–2026 reviews). Non-smoking; children welcome. Cards (JCB, Amex, Diners per Tabelog); no e-money or QR. Ground floor of ユニバース会館 on Tominaga-cho east of Nawate, south side.
kyoto_sumiyaki_miyazawa_gion.notes: [Yakitori · Gion Tominaga-cho, binchotan-grilled Kyoto akajidori] A snug 10-seat counter off Nawate where Kyoto akajidori goes over binchotan: rare breast, smoky tsukune, soft quail eggs and good vegetable skewers, with egg-over-rice or curry to finish. Prices are clear for Gion — about ¥10,000 for a big meal with drinks (March 2026). Book ahead. Closed Sundays and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2020 to 2026 call it a hidden gem and a favourite, praising precise grilling, the freedom to order skewer by skewer, and clear pricing; one March 2026 diner paid ¥10,164 for 11 skewers, sides, a rice finish and several shochu sodas. The September 2026 reviewer took the omakase, "allowing the chef to serve me his recommendations".

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "Even in Gion, this place offers clear pricing and is a great restaurant."
January 2025: "The grilled tsukune may look burnt, but it wasn't bitter at all and was delicious!"

Kept in Kyoto by a double typhoon in June 2026, a family with three small children called ahead and found the second-floor tatami room otherwise empty; the children loved the duck breast.
A solo June 2026 diner marked summer with hamo sashimi and Kamo eggplant agedashi over a draft beer.

kyoto_silk_pound_cake.notes: [Pound cake · Gokomachi] A takeaway pound-cake specialist near Nishiki Market with an arched door: glazed Lemon Sweet, mini cakes of pistachio-cherry or blueberry-cheese around ¥500, and seasonal sakura or apple, in pretty Kyoto gift bags. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.philosophy: Pound cakes pursuing a smooth, rich sweetness, for a luxurious moment (official site).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 visitor thought the shopfront looked like a nail salon, then chose blueberry, pistachio and lemon mini cakes from more than ten kinds.
An April 2026 buyer of three cakes, including a spring Sakura Pound, was taken with the Kyoto-styled shopping bag.
A January 2025 reviewer found the Lemon Sweet's glaze stronger than its lemon.

kyoto_ryuan_gion_shijo.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku · Gion-Shijo] A calm yakiniku of private and semi-private rooms by the Kamo River at Gion-Shijo: good-value yaki-shabu lunches around ¥1,600 and, at night, Kobe and Omi wagyu — tongue in several cuts, chateaubriand, stone-pot liver — from about ¥10,000. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: A Gion-Shijo yakiniku restaurant (official site; Tabelog) whose menu opens by promising "the best meat of your life" (October 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: Starting a meat trip in January 2026, a diner had the Kobe and Omi special set and added a thick Omi chateaubriand for ¥3,000.
A January 2026 lunch guest caught one of the five daily raw hamburg steaks, tender enough to eat with a spoon.
An October 2026 diner called the ¥25,000 course not expensive, from Kobe beef carpaccio to three cuts of tongue.

kyoto_yumeya_kiyamachi_late.notes: [Izakaya · Nishi-Kiyamachi, midnight to 8 a.m.] A long-running izakaya that only opens at midnight, the last stop after Kiyamachi's bars: fresh daily sashimi, fried horse mackerel, simmered shellfish, tempura and dashimaki, finishing with kitsune udon or a rice bowl. Counter only. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a long-established counter izakaya on Nishi-Kiyamachi open from midnight until 8 a.m., a regular last stop for people coming off a night out (2018–2026).

anecdotes.text: A June 2018 group, flagging at 4 a.m., shared kitsune udon, hoya with ponzu and grilled thick tofu — the tofu a little underdone.
A July 2022 regular who comes after drinking calls the fried horse mackerel exceptional and the sashimi always fresh.
A June 2026 visitor on the last night of a trip found it more of a proper izakaya than expected, with a ¥900 conger and negi tempura.

kyoto_sashimi_no_gyoshin.notes: [Fish izakaya · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, sashimi] A quiet, tucked-away izakaya true to its name: a platter of eight kinds of sashimi, two pieces each, then the head of the day's fish grilled or braised as you like, kinmedai, guji and ankimo, with sake. A May 2026 reviewer saw a sign saying only Japanese speakers are served. One found the simmered fish bony, another the sake list short. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a seafood izakaya of 25 seats east of the BAL building. Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe very fresh sashimi, fish heads of the day prepared to order, reasonable prices and a quiet room with few tourists.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; fish head of the day.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor saw a sign at the entrance saying the shop only accommodates those who can communicate in Japanese.
A May 2026 business group found the braised kijihata head the highlight — the speciality is the day's fish head done as you like.
A May 2025 pair loved the sashimi but found the simmered fish bony and hard to eat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮・居酒屋、中京区河原町通三条下ル四筋目BALビル東入ル山崎町246-102 クラリオンビル 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、火〜日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、月曜休み、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、25席、カウンター、禁煙。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年5月、英語): 雑居ビル1階の奥、静かで観光客が少ない、8種2切れずつの刺身の盛り合わせ (さんま、地元の白身など)、その日の魚のかしらを好みの調理で (鯛のかぶと焼き、きじはたの煮付け)、きんめだいの煮付け、ぐじの焼き物、あん肝、さざえの煮物、わかさぎの唐揚げ、天ぷら、日本酒、サワー、クラフトビール、入口に「日本語でコミュニケーションできる方のみ」の張り紙があったとの声 (2026年5月)、煮魚は骨が多いとの声 (2025年5月)、日本酒の種類が少ないとの声 (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese speakers only, per an entrance sign seen in May 2026; counter; cards.

kyoto_babele_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Daily obanzai and ethnic small plates — yum woon sen, simmered and fried vegetables — but also pasta, yakisoba and fries; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_babele_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Several vegetable obanzai (eggplant in broth, red konnyaku, Jerusalem artichoke salad), but dashi, egg and fish are common; no ingredient information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_babele_gion.hours_raw: Wednesday–Friday 18:00–2:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 15:00–24:00; closed Monday and Tuesday, and Sunday and Monday in the last week of the month; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards accepted (Tabelog). A large shared table; private hire for up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). Tabelog notes the menu has moved from Italian to obanzai and ethnic dishes. 1F of the Gion Nawate White building, down a narrow alley north of Shijo off Yamato-oji; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2025).
kyoto_babele_gion.notes: [Obanzai bar · Gion, off Nawate] A warm little bar at the end of a narrow alley near Shinbashi, where the owner cooks a changing spread of gently seasoned obanzai and ethnic plates — eggplant in broth, yam pouches, yum woon sen, squid shiokara with butter cabbage — plus pasta and yakisoba, with wine or sake at a big shared table. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a wine bar first listed as Italian that has moved to obanzai and ethnic dishes. Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe hand-made dishes by the woman who runs it, subtle seasoning, warm conversation and a homely feel.

anecdotes.text: A July 2024 diner was struck by obanzai seasoned far more gently than at tourist-facing places, and by yum woon sen with adjustable heat.
A November 2024 fan tried to recreate the squid shiokara with cabbage and butter at home and could not match it.
An October 2026 regular orders the Jerusalem artichoke salad whenever it appears.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ワインバー、東山区大和大路通四条上ル三丁目弁財天町13 祇園縄手ホワイトビル 1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、水〜金 18:00〜翌2:00、土日祝 15:00〜24:00、月・火曜休み (月末の週は日・月曜休み)、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード可、禁煙、20名まで貸切可、業態が変わり今はイタリアンよりおばんざいとエスニック料理。口コミ (2020年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 細い路地の奥、店主の女性の手作り、日替わりのおばんざい、山芋と卵白の袋煮に卵黄、赤こんにゃくの煮物、なすの揚げびたし、辛さを選べるヤムウンセン、いかの塩辛とキャベツのバター炒め、胡椒のポテトサラダ、鯖などの日替わりパスタ、焼きそば、菊芋のサラダ、フライドポテト、大きなテーブル、日本酒、ワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Small, chatty bar with a shared table; cards.

kyoto_201_gion_wagyu_wine_bar.gf_detail: Not GF: pasta, pizza and carbonara alongside steak (2022–2024 reviews).
kyoto_201_gion_wagyu_wine_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu steak, roast beef sushi, prosciutto and cheese (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_201_gion_wagyu_wine_bar.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 18:00–1:00; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Charge ¥500 (Tabelog original チャージ料500円頂戴しております。). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 14 seats at the counter and tables, plus a private room for up to 4; smoking allowed at all seats (Tabelog). 2F of the Lancelot building in Gion Yasaka-shinchi, up a narrow entrance; 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; December 2021). Opened 11 July 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_201_gion_wagyu_wine_bar.notes: [Wine bar · Gion Yasaka-shinchi, till 1 a.m.] A hidden second-floor bar in Gion where a sommelier owner pours wine, Champagne and whisky alongside proper food: steak of the day, roast beef temari sushi, carbonara and Spanish ham with persimmon — for a full course or a late second stop, with a private room for birthdays. ¥500 charge; smoking allowed. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a dining and wine bar opened 11 July 2019 in Gion, with wines, Champagne and whisky chosen by the owner-sommelier. A December 2021 reviewer knew it as Dining bar MO-JI; a November 2024 reviewer refers to the owner as the mama.
chef_bio.philosophy: Proper food until late, with the owner's chosen wines (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Steak of the day; roast beef temari sushi.

anecdotes.text: An October 2022 birthday pair took a private room on a course of about ¥5,000, added pasta and cheese, and found sparkling wine only by the half bottle — about ¥24,000 for two with a surprise plate.
An August 2026 regular who usually comes just to drink had the steak of the day — lean, high-quality red meat.
A December 2021 guest, taken there by a friend, had walked past the narrow entrance many times without noticing it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・ワインバー・イタリアン、東山区八坂新地末吉町99-3 ランスロットビル 2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、火〜土 18:00〜翌1:00、日・月曜休み、予約可、チャージ料500円、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、14席、4名までの個室、全席喫煙可、2019年7月11日開店、ソムリエの店主が選ぶワイン・シャンパン・ウイスキー。口コミ (2021年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 以前は Dining bar MO-JI との声、入口が狭く見落としやすい、本日のステーキ、ローストビーフの手毬寿司、カルボナーラなどのパスタ、ピザ、スペインの生ハムと柿のバルサミコ、チーズの盛り合わせ、5,000円ほどのコース、スパークリングはハーフボトルのみ6,000円ほど (2022年10月)、誕生日のプレート。

cultural_comfort.note: Hidden upstairs bar; ¥500 charge; smoking allowed; cards.

kyoto_sushi_hayashi.gf_detail: Ask. An omakase of sushi and seasonal appetisers; the rice is said to be made without sugar and the soup is a clear bonito broth, but no gluten information is published (Tabelog; May 2025).
kyoto_sushi_hayashi.hours_raw: Reservation only. Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:30) Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday; dinner 18:00–21:00 (last entry 18:30) Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday; closed Wednesday and Thursday, plus irregular days (Tabelog). Prices include tax and service; cancellation charge 100% on the day, 50% the two days before (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 9 counter seats; no children; smart casual; non-smoking (Tabelog). Run by a couple (2021 reviews). 6 min walk from Keihan Demachiyanagi Stn, 12 min from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_hayashi.notes: [Sushi · north of the Imperial Palace, a couple's nine-seat omakase] A quiet, dimly lit nine-seat counter near Demachiyanagi run by a sushi master and wife: a pure, restrained omakase — sugar-free rice, barely seasoned gari, clear bonito soup — with nodoguro, anago and uni among the pieces, and sake or Swiss wine. Listed by Michelin six years running, per the shop. About ¥20,000–40,000; booking only; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef, with the owner’s wife front of house (2021 reviews); names not given
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 May 2019 (Tabelog). Tabelog’s introduction: listed in the Michelin Guide for six consecutive years; sushi and seasonal appetisers made with fresh ingredients sourced directly from the area; two omakase courses at lunch and one at dinner. Reviewers (2021) describe a friendly owner and the owner’s wife running it together.

anecdotes.text: A December 2021 first-timer, after years of wanting to come, found the hostess’s smiles soothing.
An October 2021 guest came for the Swiss wine and ordered the dinner course at lunch.
A May 2025 diner found the fatty tuna surprisingly light and the style "transparent", with nothing superfluous.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮓はやし、寿司・魚介料理・日本料理、上京区表町31-1、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩6分、地下鉄今出川駅から徒歩12分、完全予約制、昼 火土日 12:00〜14:00 (最終入店12:30)、夜 月火金土日 18:00〜21:00 (最終入店18:30)、水木定休、ほか不定休、税・サービス料込み、キャンセル料 当日100%・前日と前々日50%、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター9席、子ども不可、スマートカジュアル、禁煙、2019年5月6日オープン。公式紹介: ミシュランガイドに6年連続掲載、地元直送の旬の食材の鮨と酒肴、昼はおまかせ2種・夜は1種、銘酒。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、砂糖を使わない酢飯、味付けを抑えたガリ、鰹のすまし汁、穴子、鯛、海老と雲丹、鰹、煮蛸、のどぐろ、烏賊、きす、甘鯛、スイスワイン、一人20,000〜40,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Booking only; no children; smart casual.

kyoto_kitocafe.gf_detail: Ask. Cakes — shortcakes, tarte Tatin, cheesecake, gâteau chocolat — and lunch plates such as a fried hamburg, sandwiches and borscht; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_kitocafe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream cakes, hamburg and chicken plates (reviews).
kyoto_kitocafe.hours_raw: 11:30–17:00 Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings accepted. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 17 seats: a small counter and tables, window seats; non-smoking (Tabelog; March 2025). Fills quickly on weekends, with queues (March 2025). Cakes to take away (Tabelog). Up the stairs on the 2nd floor off the Demachi shopping street, 1 min from the Kawaramachi-Imadegawa bus stop (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_kitocafe.notes: [Café · Demachi, seasonal shortcakes upstairs] A calm second-floor café just off the Demachi shopping street, with a blackboard lunch — a Greek-style hamburg or chicken plate with soup and rice for about ¥1,100 — and beautiful seasonal cakes: towering strawberry or peach shortcake, tarte Tatin, cheesecake. Busy at weekends; cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 October 2010 (Tabelog). A March 2026 reviewer says it is run by one person; an October 2026 reviewer was welcomed by two women.

anecdotes.text: A three-time visitor (November 2024) came back for the Jonathan-apple tarte Tatin.
An August 2026 visitor finally made it after three or four years of meaning to, for the peach shortcake.
A March 2025 couple after cherry-blossom viewing were seated at once; a queue had formed by the time of leaving.

kyoto_green_farm_demachi.gf_detail: Ask. Soft serve, milk-pudding soft serve, smoothies and juices; cones and toppings not described (reviews).
kyoto_green_farm_demachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dairy company’s milk soft serve; the fruit smoothies may be milk-free but are not described (reviews).
kyoto_green_farm_demachi.hours_raw: Hours are not listed on Tabelog, and the shop website (greenfarm.link) did not respond (2026-11-07) — check before going. 10 seats per Tabelog; a few seats inside (about four) and terrace seating outside (November 2025); non-smoking (Tabelog). On Yanagi-dori, about 5 min walk from Keihan Demachiyanagi Stn, near the Hyakumanben handmade market at Chion-ji (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_green_farm_demachi.notes: [Soft serve · Demachiyanagi, a dairy's milk-and-smoothie stand] A small shop on Yanagi-dori run by a long-established dairy, pouring soft serve and a soft milk pudding made with Miyama milk, fruit smoothies and a milk tasting. Most people take a cone outside or to the terrace. Handy after the Hyakumanben handmade market. Hours aren't published — check before going.

roles: Run by a dairy company dating to the Taisho era (2023–2024 reviews); not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 23 November 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2023–2024) describe a shop run by a milk company dating back to the Taisho era, serving Miyama milk soft serve and smoothies; a July 2026 reviewer did a milk tasting.

anecdotes.text: An October 2023 visitor came on the Hyakumanben handmade-market day and chose from several milks.
A March 2024 diner found the taste ordinary for the price.
A self-described regular (August 2025) waits each year for the fig smoothie.

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; mostly takeaway.

kyoto_le_sucrier.gf_detail: Ask. A patisserie of cream puffs, shortcakes, chestnut cakes, cheesecake and pudding; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_le_sucrier.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg, butter and cream pastries (reviews).
kyoto_le_sucrier.hours_raw: 11:30–18:30 Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday; Sunday café from 14:00; closed Tuesday and Friday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A small café area behind the cake counter, 15 seats; non-smoking; takeout (Tabelog; March 2025). On Teramachi just north of Imadegawa, on the way to the Masugata shopping street, 8 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_le_sucrier.notes: [Patisserie · Teramachi-Imadegawa, a 1990 neighbourhood cake shop] A slightly dim, antique-styled cake shop just north of Imadegawa, with a showcase of carefully made cakes and a small café behind: cream puffs, a chestnut-and-rum Mon Carré, spice caramel, cheesecake and pudding with a deep-roast coffee. Many take cakes to the Kamo delta. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Friday.

chef_bio.background: Per a September 2024 reviewer, established in 1990 and loved by locals. Reviewers (2021–2026) describe an antique-feeling shop with a cake case at the front and a café at the back.

anecdotes.text: A May 2022 visitor took cream puffs to the Kamo delta, remembering a hawk that once snatched a snack there.
An August 2025 guest smelled eggs and butter on entering and paired a cream puff and pudding with iced coffee.
A March 2026 regular struggled to put into words how good the chestnut Mon Carré was.
